selection_policy: Use the previously frozen training-CV single-model leaders; do not select again using validation or test metrics.

current_benchmark.patient_splits: Each hospital 70/15/15, fixed original patient lists
current_benchmark.label_scope: Original full-record SepsisLabel, including available post-onset hours
current_benchmark.utility_alarm_rule: Hourly decisions at the frozen validation threshold, no cooldown
current_benchmark.interpretation: Historically exposed exploratory patient holdout within two known hospitals

planned_project_comparison.shared_feature_profile: 789-column causal information for any new current-benchmark comparison
planned_project_comparison.comparison_requirement: Choose and record one common patient list, hourly eligibility mask, feature information, outcome definition, and evaluation protocol before fitting LR or EBM. Do not merge old 312-feature pre-onset results into the new full-record table.

lr.preprocessing: Fit missing-value imputation and standardization on fitting patients only; reuse those parameters for inner calibration and held patients

ebm.patient_isolation: Fit binning and any early-stopping/calibration components without held patients; do not split a patient's hours across fitting and calibration

proposal_target_protocol.population: Adult ICU hours before first sepsis onset, predicting onset within the next six hours
proposal_target_protocol.development: Hospital A patient-level 70/15/15 with training-only patient CV
proposal_target_protocol.transfer_evaluation: Hospital B reserved for transfer evaluation in the original proposal
proposal_target_protocol.primary_metric: Pre-onset AUPRC under a false-alert budget
proposal_target_protocol.clinical_alarm_rule: At most one false episode per 100 eligible patient-hours; six-hour repeated-alert suppression
